description.text: The seventh expansion of the Scarlet & Violet series, released on 19 July 2024. Terapagos ex, from the game's Indigo Disk story, leads it, and with it came the first Pokémon of the Stellar Tera Type, such as Lapras ex and Galvantula ex, whose attacks need Energy of three different types but do great damage or have strong effects. Hydrapple ex, Dachsbun ex and Cinderace ex join them, with Noctowl, whose Ability takes two Trainer cards from the deck when it evolves if its player has a Tera Pokémon, the Blueberry League's Elite Four Crispin and Lacey as Supporters for the first time, Briar, and the ACE SPEC cards Sparkling Crystal, Deluxe Bomb and Grand Tree. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 102, followed by Art Rare Pokémon, Super Rare Pokémon ex and Supporters, Special Art Rare cards, and Ultra Rare Terapagos ex, Bravery Charm and Area Zero Underdepths. In English most of its cards came out in Stellar Crown in September 2024.
